STAGE 1

Write the whole-module specification

InputClean RTL module: autovcoder_085821.v
InstructionDescribe the whole module’s interface and observable behavior in self-contained prose.

Protocol summary; exact prompt wording is retained by the evaluation runner, not this historical import.

OutputGenerated whole-module specification (prose).
Read input: autovcoder_085821.v · Open raw
module autovcoder_085821 (
    input [6:0] DI,
    input CLK,
    input nDSYNC,
    output reg [6:0] R_o,
    output reg [6:0] G_o,
    output reg [6:0] B_o,
    output reg nCSYNC,
    output reg nHSYNC,
    output reg nVSYNC,
    output reg nCLAMP
);

  reg [6:0] R_i;
  reg [6:0] G_i;
  reg [6:0] B_i;

  reg [1:0] cnt;
  reg skip;
  reg [2:0] serrcount;  // 240p: 3 hsync per vsync; 480i: 6 serrated hsync per vsync
  reg [1:0] linecount;  // PAL: Linecount[1:0] = 01; NTSC: Linecount[1:0] = 11
  reg vmode;

  always @(negedge CLK) begin
    if (~nDSYNC) begin
      cnt <= 2'b00;
      {nVSYNC, nCLAMP, nHSYNC, nCSYNC} <= DI[3:0];
      if (~nVSYNC & DI[3]) begin
        vmode <= linecount[1];
        linecount <= 0;
      end
      if (~nHSYNC & DI[1]) linecount <= linecount + 1;
      if (nVSYNC & ~DI[3]) serrcount <= 0;
      if (~nCSYNC & DI[0]) begin
        skip <= 0;
        // count up hsync pulses during vsync pulse
        if (~nVSYNC) serrcount <= serrcount + 1;
      end else skip <= ~skip;
      R_o <= R_i;
      G_o <= G_i;
      B_o <= B_i;
    end else begin
      cnt <= cnt + 1;
      if (serrcount[2] | (skip ^ ~vmode)) begin
        case (cnt)
          2'b00: R_i <= DI;
          2'b01: G_i <= DI;
          2'b10: B_i <= DI;
        endcase
      end
    end
  end
endmodule
